payload.text: Utilz 2.14.9's candidate CI would skip macOS: utilz's tests.yml runs test-macos (:115), the rust matrix's macOS row (:285), menuz-app (:534) and Test Summary's MACOS_REQUIRED (:598) only on a tag or a dispatch, while 0.1.19's cut tags only after CI is green on candidate/<tag>, so unless utilz/dc's ST0031/04 moves all four to devbin's own startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/heads/candidate/') (devbin's tests.yml :192, :355, :546) the candidate reads green on Linux alone. AC-5.4's Utilz facts are dc's (its hold of 2026-11-02). Held until hv answers Q1 of cc's plan of 2026-11-02: cc sends it to devbin-vc for utilz/vc and utilz/dc, hv says it in utilz/vc's window, or it is left to ST0031/04's review.
